args.thought: I need to join expense with member tables, calculate average cost, and filter for expenses above average. I'll use a subquery or CTE to get the average cost first, then filter. The question asks for full name (first_name, last_name) and contact number (phone).
args.sql:
SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, m.phone
FROM expense e
JOIN member m ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
WHERE e.cost > (SELECT AVG(cost) FROM expense)
ORDER BY m.first_name, m.last_name
